listen.title: Listen
description: Explore the map to discover and listen to recordings from the community. Navigate through different locations and experience the collective voice of the invisible choir.
Use the filters to find specific types of recordings or browse by date and tags.

add choir.title: Add Choir
description: Record and contribute your voice to the community choir. Choose a location on the map and start your recording journey.
Your recording will become part of the collective soundscape that others can discover and listen to.

rehearse.title: Rehearse
description: Listen to the base track and get familiar with the rhythm and melody before recording your contribution.
Take your time to practice and feel comfortable with the musical loop. This is your chance to prepare before adding your voice to the choir.

recording.title: Recording
description: Sing along with the base track to create your contribution to the choir. The loop will play while you record your voice.
Make sure you're in a quiet environment and speak clearly. Your recording will be mixed with the base track for the final result.

review.title: Review
description: Review your recording mixed with the base loop. Listen carefully to ensure you're satisfied with your contribution.
If you're not happy with the result, you can re-record. Once you're satisfied, your voice will be added to the community choir.

welcome.title: Welcome
description: Join the collective voice of the community. Listen to existing recordings or add your own voice to create a unique soundscape.
Navigate through the app to explore recordings by location, or contribute your own voice to the growing choir.

help.title: Help
description: This help section provides guidance on how to use the Invisible Choir app effectively.
Browse through different sections to learn about listening, recording, and contributing to the community choir.

tags.title: Tags
description: Use tags to categorize and organize your recordings. Tags help others discover your contributions and find similar content.
Choose relevant tags that describe the mood, style, or theme of your recording.
